  local cpath="" w i

  for ((i = 2; i < CURRENT; i++)); do
    w=$words[i]
    if (( ${names[(Ie)$w]} )); then
      cpath="${cpath:+$cpath }$w"
      _purchasely_node "$cpath"
    fi
  done
  _describe -t commands 'command' subs
  _describe -t options 'option' opts
}

_acme() {
  local cpath="" w i
  local -a names subs opts
  _acme_node ""
  for ((i = 2; i < CURRENT; i++)); do
    w=$words[i]
    if (( ${names[(Ie)$w]} )); then
      cpath="${cpath:+$cpath }$w"
      _acme_node "$cpath"
    fi
  done
  _describe -t commands 'command' subs
  _describe -t options 'option' opts
}

function __acme_at

  for w in (commandline -opc)[2..-1]

_purchasely() {
  local cpath="" w i
  local -a names subs opts
  _purchasely_node ""
  for ((i = 2; i < CURRENT; i++)); do
    w=$words[i]
    if (( ${names[(Ie)$w]} )); then
      cpath="${cpath:+$cpath }$w"
      _purchasely_node "$cpath"
    fi
  done
  _describe -t commands 'command' subs
  _describe -t options 'option' opts
}
if [ "$funcstack[1]" = "_purchasely" ]; then _purchasely "$@"; else compdef _purchasely purchasely; fi
